name: Road of Mailhem
description: PSX style parkour runner through a zombie wasteland.
long_description:
In a world overrun by Zombies there’s only one way to get essential supplies between strongholds: parkour runners brave the zombie infested roads to deliver packages between centres. 
In this PS1 classic styled game you take on the mantle of Runner braving against vicious zombies, and get a taste of the game as it could be!

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
